'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Woody McClure DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Woody McClure]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Woody
* '''Deck name:''' Borrowing 10 DDroids?
* '''Username:''' McClure
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
